interpretation.auto: SDK DONE at 30001ms/events0, cache NORMAL55 -> IDLE5 -> NORMAL55; operator did not notice dimming, physical static observation inconclusive
interpretation.key: Operator saw dimming but did not press KEY. Actual malformed report caused helper error, then explicit stop; CANCELLED at4568ms/events0. Not evidence of touch wake or KEY cancellation
interpretation.auto-retry: CANCELLED at5935ms/events0x80, cache restored55. Native wrist source event85h/axes40h followed; helper sent no stop. Not a 30-second static pass
interpretation.cleanup_note: auto-retry recorded cleanup_verified=false because the old helper assigned it only after outcome assertions. The complete terminal status actually has reserved0/restore_pending0/restored1; allow1 and port close are logged. The later helper separates cleanup from outcome
interpretation.auto-isolated-2: With wrist wake temporarily disabled, DONE at30001ms/events0; NORMAL55 -> IDLE5 -> NORMAL55, reserved0/restore_pending0/restored1, no collector stop. Operator confirmed stable dim picture and automatic restore
interpretation.key-isolated: CANCELLED at5076ms/events0, restored55, reserved0/restore_pending0/restored1, no collector stop. Operator confirmed one KEY restored display and release did not navigate; stable HOME page0 after window
interpretation.steps_fault: Both isolated postreads report daily phase4/end3/io_errors1/sample1407569/stop_verified1, valid0/partial1, checkpoint total0/generation64. The fault sample predates both isolated starts; no failed bus transaction captured and AOD causation unknown
interpretation.freeze: After panel windows, operator reported frozen between HOME and the left page, touch unresponsive; photo preserved. Seven read-only queries produced zero UART bytes. One operator short KEY left picture unchanged; separate90s passive wait produced zero bytes and sent no commands. Both sessions closed normally, no PM hold/reset/clock change
interpretation.acceptance: Two bounded panel observations passed; whole-device closeout failed. Wrist preference and temporary-awake restoration not confirmed
interpretation.recovery-001: Single authorized RTS150ms at2026-10-22T14:53:02.848235Z; original firmware retained. Storage restored, steps valid1/native0/io_errors0, checkpoint total0/generation64; wrist requested0/armed0. Phone set current UTC before show_date, no host wf_time. allow1/off1/own_idle0/sdk_idle0 and closed14:53:17.816765Z
interpretation.recovery-observe-001: Passive180s capture, no commands/reset/PM/time writes,2373 UART bytes. KEY1 -> touch Power up done -> screen on -> thread:main stack overflow. Main pri19/ready/SP0x2003d680/top0x2003f690/size0x2000/max100%. SDK top is stack_addr+size-4, so SP20B below stack bottom. Scheduler fatal path disables interrupts and waits. User reports lit display but touch unavailable
interpretation.causation: This reset session never started AOD and captures actual main-stack overflow after ordinary KEY wake. It explains this post-reset halt but does not prove the original zero-byte freeze or earlier IMU fault had the same cause. Deepest call chain and corruption not excluded
